parameters.scope: All10 existing E012 groups,308..3316 runes, covering55 unknown rune pages and retaining numeric LP2-50. Overlapping alternative groupings remain distinct hypotheses, not authenticated cipher boundaries.
parameters.selection: Highest fourgram mean score across10groups; stable plan order breaks ties. Freeze selection and all observed output hashes before nulls.
parameters.solver: Frozen E062 autokey_extended_search.search over4..32 and four signs; no skipped symbols. Concatenate existing canonical rune streams in original page order. parameters.gate: All16 exact plaintext/key/a/b and true family retained. Independent raw-source, literal screening, score, queue and reencryption checks. If gate fails, no unknown scan with this solver; preserve failure and classify screening vs optimizer. No parameter tuning in E068.

parameters.null: One full optimizer interior-shuffle null of newcontrol5 with Random3302068; preserve counts,endpoints,adjacent equality; rejection cap100000. Diagnostic only, no pvalue.
parameters.optimizer: E066 budget per retained family:8 starts,6 trigram coordinate sweeps,keep2; beam cuts0,m//2,width128,keep2/cut; top12 distinct fourgram candidates,6 refinement sweeps,top3 plaintexts. Start seed3303068+784*m+28*(a-1)+b-1. All coefficients modulo29.
parameters.screen: Enumerate22736 families; per period order a1..28 then b1..28. Score=sum over residues max over29 prefix symbols of unigram log likelihood. Use histogram identity P_i=a*(base1_i+t*coeff_i), prefix=a*t, a a unit; per residue histogram29x29 then dot with logp(a*x). This changes computation, not objective. Rank by score rounded to9 decimal places, ties by fixed a,b order; retain8 per period,232 full families. Store raw scores and rounded selection scores. Independent literal evaluation and unit tests must agree within1e-7.
parameters.unknown: Separate plan only after successful controls and independent verification. Full optimizer matched nulls and correction over all input selection required.

parameters.benchmark: Random3302071 uniform3316-rune stream, all29 periods and659344 families; retain8 per period. Unigram logp proportional to symbols1..29, deterministic nonuniform fixture.
parameters.formula: P_i=a*C_i+b*P_(i-m)+c mod29. For b!=1 use d=c/(1-b), P_i=a*(base1_i+b^q*t_r)+d. For b=1 use P_i=a*(base1_i+t_r)+q*c. q=floor(i/m). All 29 prefixes are represented bijectively. Scoring must include d or q*c; constant is NOT already covered by c=0 scoring.
parameters.gate: All direct comparisons <=1e-7 and full synthetic screen <60seconds. No tuning within this registered experiment.
parameters.null: Synthetic uniform stream is a throughput fixture, not an inferential null experiment. Fresh positive language controls and complete optimizer matched nulls are separately required before unknown inference.
parameters.purpose: Independent algebra and screening validation plus bounded synthetic runtime benchmark; no unknown pages or language inference.
parameters.validation: Fixed Random3301071 uniform41-rune cipher at m4. Direct vectorized queue enumeration of all29 prefixes for every a,b,c (22736 families), independent of production chain/histogram. Compare unigram maxima with tolerance1e-7. For m13,32 also compare every b,c and a1,7,28 on101 runes. No optimized language candidates.

parameters.controls: 12 fresh keys Random3301072+index. Same excluded Emerson blocks as E068 controls0..11, previously inspected texts, not unseen prose. a=(2,7,14,27)[index%4]; b=(1,3,15)[index%3]; c=(5*index+1)%28+1. m13/23/31, except index11m32. Four regressions reuse exact E068 INPUTS0,3,6,11 with c0 under changed solver. All16 run even if a recovery gate fails.
parameters.gate: All16 full plaintexts and key/a/b/c exact, true family retained; independent source/queue/screen/score checks before unknown scan. If gate fails, preserve result and investigate screening versus optimizer, with no tuning in this experiment.
parameters.mechanism: P_i=a*C_i+b*P_(i-m)+c mod29; a,b1..28,c0..28,m4..32. Initial key=(P-a*C-c)/b; encrypt=(P-b*queue-c)/a. No skips or resets.
parameters.null: One diagnostic full-optimizer null of control5. Interior shuffle Random3302072, preserve endpoints/counts/adjacent equality,100000 rejection cap. No inferential pvalue from this diagnostic.
parameters.optimizer: Same fixed E068 budget:8 starts,6 trigram sweeps,keep2; cyclic beam cuts0,m//2,width128,keep2/cut; top12 distinct family/prefix candidates,6 fourgram sweeps,top3 distinct plaintexts. Seed3303072+22736*m+812*(a-1)+29*(b-1)+c. No optimization of c after family selection.
parameters.screen: For each period rank all a,b,c in lexicographic order by np.round(score,9), stable ties. Retain8 per period (232 total). Store all floating/rounded score digests in little-endian float64 plus top8, and true family rank for controls. Different machines may differ in final float bits; independent numeric check tolerance1e-7 and rounded ranking are authoritative.
parameters.unknown: Separate preregistration only after controls and independent validation. Matched full-optimizer nulls and correction across all inputs mandatory.

parameters.inference: Plus-one p=(1+exceedances)/20; Bonferroni56 across page/group selection irrespective of overlaps. Minimum adjusted p is1 with19nulls. Coarse rejection screen only, no significance claim; zero exceedances requires separately preregistered larger calibration.
parameters.limits: Heuristic top8 screening, not exhaustive key search. E071 independently enumerates27608 family scores; each attack independently checks232 retained families and replays complete screen. No skipped runes or hidden boundaries. Grouping unauthenticated. No community claims.
parameters.null: 19 independent selected-input nulls, per-page interior shuffle preserving counts,endpoints,adjacent-equality and empty spans; rejection cap100000/page. Entire family screening and optimizer repeated.
parameters.required_gate: All16 E072 plaintext/key/a/b/c exact and injected families retained; independent source/queue/retained-family/score checks and full-screen deterministic replay passed.
parameters.scope: 46 single LP2 pages of at least200 runes followed by10 existing groups; all55 unknown rune pages represented, empty numeric LP2-50 preserved. Group boundaries and page resets are hypotheses.
parameters.selection: Highest mean fourgram score among56 inputs, stable plan order for ties. Freeze winner and all56 output hashes before nulls.
parameters.solver: Frozen E072,659344 families,top8 per period,232 full optimizations,12 refinements. a,b1..28,c0..28,m4..32. No skips, no language/key resets within inputs. Same parameters for observed/null.

parameters.inference: Plus-one p=(1+exceedances)/20; Bonferroni56 across page/group selection irrespective of overlaps. Minimum adjusted p is1 with19nulls. Coarse rejection screen only, no significance claim; zero exceedances requires separately preregistered larger calibration.
parameters.limits: Heuristic top8 screening, not exhaustive key search. E071 independently enumerates27608 family scores; each attack independently checks232 retained families and replays complete screen. No skipped runes or hidden boundaries. Grouping unauthenticated. No community claims.
parameters.null: 19 independent selected-input nulls, per-page interior shuffle preserving counts,endpoints,adjacent-equality and empty spans; rejection cap100000/page. Entire family screening and optimizer repeated.
parameters.required_gate: All16 E072 plaintext/key/a/b/c exact and injected families retained; independent source/queue/retained-family/score checks and full-screen deterministic replay passed.
parameters.scope: 46 single LP2 pages of at least200 runes followed by10 existing groups; all55 unknown rune pages represented, empty numeric LP2-50 preserved. Group boundaries and page resets are hypotheses.
parameters.selection: Highest mean fourgram score among56 inputs, stable plan order for ties. Freeze winner and all56 output hashes before nulls.
parameters.solver: Frozen E072,659344 families,top8 per period,232 full optimizations,12 refinements. a,b1..28,c0..28,m4..32. No skips, no language/key resets within inputs. Same parameters for observed/null.

parameters.arithmetic: All regression-neighbor and heldout sequence scores compared between vector and scalar implementations within1e-9; unit tests cover independent event counts, conditional normalization, EOS, and batch scores.
parameters.diagnostic: E080 evaluates truth and every406 single symbol-transposition neighbor of each regression; ignore swaps leaving plaintext unchanged for ranking gate. Compare previous E036 selected wrong plaintext as a preserved diagnostic, never relabel old results.
parameters.followup: Only on E080 gate, preregister E081 fresh-permutation blind-key search on3regressions+6excluded Emerson windows, plus3 full-search diagnostic nulls for shortest regression. Unchanged E036 starts/warmup, then40 all406-swap sweeps using new word score. All controls exact on observed symbols before separately registered unknown scan with full matched nulls and selection correction.
parameters.gate: All three true regression texts strictly exceed every distinct one-swap neighbor by1e-12; new heldout strict-win rate>=0.95 and no loss vs old exceeding0.01; scalar/vector agreement. These local checks do not establish global optimizer recovery.
parameters.heldout: Same18 E036 windows: first6 paragraphs with at least20 words in each of X,XI,XII, first20 words. Fresh20 single-position nonzero mutations per window, Random3304080. Known inspected text, fresh draws. Compare unchanged E036 word score to new score on identical samples.
parameters.limits: General substitution heuristic; not a29! exhaustive search. Page edges assumed word endpoints. No historical text decryption inferred from synthetic substitution recovery. Failed gate blocks unknown search; do not tune against this outcome in the same batch.
parameters.model: Order4 hierarchical Dirichlet conditional events over29 runes plus EOS=30; BOS=29 only in context, three initial BOS per word. alpha0.5,strength5. Count all word-token events including EOS and all suffix context lengths0..3. Q(w) product including EOS. Q permits empty emissions; full word distribution (count(w)+20*Q(w))/(total_word_tokens+20). Observed segments nonempty. Sum log probabilities divided by rune count. No cross-word context, apostrophe joining, edge fallback or spelling correction.
parameters.null: 19 independent exact-count shuffles per heldout window, fixed segment endpoints, seed3302080+100*window_index+replicate. Both scalar objectives and vector implementation checked. Language diagnostic only, no optimized ciphertext test or p-value; not used to select parameters.
parameters.registered_design: One fixed BOS/EOS alternative, no parameter sweep or unknown-page access for model design. Previous E036 short-control TUNNELNG->TUNNELEA failure is known, so this is a targeted general repair tested on previously inspected regression and excluded-source texts, not blind model selection.
parameters.training: Pinned pg2944.txt, split tokens from heldout_language.corpus; chaptersI,III,IV,V,VI,VII,VIII,IX only. II excluded, X/XI/XII excluded from fitting. No LP words/counts added.
